role.title: Staff Software Engineer — Tech Lead, Backend
role.requirements:
Beijing / China. Tech Lead who leads through technical excellence, NOT management authority. 8+ years software engineering, 5+ years data platforms or high-scale backend.

Must own: backend architecture for high-scale real-time data platform; distributed systems, OLAP, streaming (ClickHouse, Kafka, Druid); design reviews and key technical decisions; mentoring via code review and design pairing; CI/CD, testing, code quality bar.

AI-native baseline: fluent daily use of Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot for prototyping, review, design, docs — not optional. Integrate LLM pipelines, agent observability, intelligent data modeling.

Languages: Python, Go, Java, Scala, or Rust (proficient in at least one). Excellent English for cross-regional collaboration.

DISQUALIFY: pure people-manager without hands-on architecture; tutorial/student profiles; no evidence of distributed/streaming/OLAP systems at scale; English-only posts with no backend depth.
